purpose: Authoritative inventory of every external dataset/source integrated into global-food-genome, for a data-integration showcase diagram.
method: Scanned data/raw/, data/interim/mappings/, processed pipeline artifacts, and script/notebook references. Scales are counted from disk where possible.

sources.name: FooDB
sources.what_it_contributed: The bioactive compounds in each food — the primary food→compound chemistry layer.

scale.note: foodb_2020_04_07 CSV release; content rows from phase9 foodb_contents.parquet

sources.name: COCONUT
sources.what_it_contributed: A large natural-product compound library that expanded the compound registry ~10× beyond FooDB.

sources.name: ChEMBL
sources.what_it_contributed: Measured compound→protein bioactivity (Ki/Kd/IC50/EC50) and mechanism-of-action action types for human single-protein targets.

sources.name: BindingDB
sources.what_it_contributed: Measured compound→protein binding affinities that seed the measured half of the compound→gene graph.

sources.name: PharmGKB / ClinPGx
sources.what_it_contributed: Pharmacogenomics chemicals, genes, variants, and relationships — used in compound-master identity crosswalks and genetics-phase joins.

scale.note: License identifies ClinPGx (PharmGKB successor branding); files retain PharmGKB accession columns

sources.name: GTEx
sources.what_it_contributed: Which genes are expressed in which human tissues — the body-region / tissue-attribution layer.

sources.name: Gene Ontology (GO)
sources.what_it_contributed: Biological process / pathway terms that enrichment scores attach to (majority of pathway IDs in the gene→pathway map).

sources.name: Reactome
sources.what_it_contributed: Curated human pathway hierarchy and display names for R-HSA-* enrichment results and category profiles.

sources.name: HGNC
sources.what_it_contributed: The canonical human gene symbol namespace — the hub that UniProt, Ensembl, BindingDB, and ChEMBL targets resolve into.

sources.name: UniProt
sources.what_it_contributed: Protein accessions that bridge BindingDB/ChEMBL targets to HGNC gene symbols.
sources.download_note: Fetched from UniProt FTP during mapping build; local parquet + report retained

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central (FDC)
sources.what_it_contributed: Per-food nutrient composition and household-measure gram weights (tsp/cup → grams) for the nutrition and dose layers.

sources.name: HMDB (Human Metabolome Database)
sources.what_it_contributed: Human metabolite identities (InChIKey-linked) for metabolomics-phase compound bridging; also flagged as a backfill source for name-only foods.

sources.name: Recon3D
sources.what_it_contributed: Human metabolic reconstruction (reactions/metabolites) for Phase 11 metabolomics / microbiome pathway work.

scale.note: MATLAB model archive; integrated in Phase 11 notebook pipeline

sources.name: SEED2VMH translation
sources.what_it_contributed: Crosswalk between SEED model exchange IDs and VMH reaction/metabolite IDs for microbiome mapping.

sources.name: Phenol-Explorer
sources.what_it_contributed: Polyphenol compound classes and structures (supplemental chemistry catalog in the Phase 9 expansion download).
sources.note: Present in phase9 expansion artifacts; not a primary edge source in the live 695-node product graph

sources.name: Human Protein Atlas
sources.what_it_contributed: Tissue/cell-line protein expression reference (downloaded; GTEx is the expression source used in tissue profiles).
sources.note: On disk; product tissue layer is built from GTEx, not HPA

sources.name: Wikidata (foods)
sources.what_it_contributed: Food item labels and scientific names used in early ingredient-ontology / synonym building.

sources.name: RecipeNLG
sources.what_it_contributed: The large English recipe corpus that drives ingredient co-occurrence, string→species mapping, and landscape sampling.

scale.source: full_dataset.csv; expanded store uses recipenlg subset

sources.name: Food.com (Kaggle)
sources.what_it_contributed: Additional recipe corpus with interactions; used in the expanded recipe store and landscape sample.

sources.name: Epicurious
sources.what_it_contributed: Curated recipe set used in the expanded recipe store.

sources.name: Indian Food (Kaggle)
sources.what_it_contributed: Small Indian cuisine recipe set with regional/diet labels.

sources.name: Food_Recipe.csv (new corpus)
sources.what_it_contributed: Indian regional recipes with reliable cuisine labels for the universe-v2 ingest.

sources.name: recipes2.json (new corpus)
sources.what_it_contributed: Additional recipe JSON corpus ingested into recipes_new_v2.

sources.name: recipes3.json (new corpus / Kaggle cuisines)
sources.what_it_contributed: Large Kaggle-tagged cuisine recipe set — primary cuisine-label source for the turmeric+pepper cuisine layer.

sources.name: recipes4 (new corpus)
sources.what_it_contributed: Largest new-corpus batch with quantity-rich ingredient lines and noisy cuisine_list tags.

scale.note: CSV and JSON are the same corpus; ingest used recipes4.csv only

sources.name: recipes5.csv (new corpus)
sources.what_it_contributed: Small recipe set with reliable area (cuisine-region) labels.

sources.name: recipes_1.csv (new corpus)
sources.what_it_contributed: Present on disk but skipped at ingest — no usable ingredient column.
sources.note: Explicitly excluded from universe v2 recipe ingest

identifier_reconciliations.problem: BindingDB protein common names → HGNC symbols
identifier_reconciliations.bridge: BindingDB Target Name / UniProt accession → UniProt HUMAN_9606 idmapping + HGNC complete set → HGNC symbol (ambiguous BindingDB names flagged, not guessed)
ChEMBL target (SINGLE PROTEIN, Homo sapiens) → UniProt accession → HGNC symbol; MoA action_type retained from ChEMBL drug_mechanism
GTEx ENSG* rows joined through HGNC Ensembl cross-references before tissue scoring

identifier_reconciliations.problem: Food ingredient strings → species → FooDB → FDC
identifier_reconciliations.bridge: Recipe free text → alias/string map → SP_*/ING_* species nodes → FooDB food id (exact/Latin) → USDA FDC id (species_fdc_map_production)
Normalize to InChIKey; unify FooDB FDB* + COCONUT id + PharmGKB chemical + BindingDB ligand + ChEMBL molecule into compound_master_v2
Gene→pathway map carries both GO:* and R-HSA-*; display names resolved via go-basic.obo and ReactomePathways.txt
FDC nutrient_id joined to FDA Daily Value table by nutrient name / id for %DV panels
SEED2VMH_translation maps SEED EX_* exchange ids to VMH ids; Recon3D supplies the reaction network

heterogeneity_metric.one_sentence: Twenty-seven heterogeneous sources spanning seven data categories — food chemistry (FooDB, COCONUT, HMDB), pharmacology (ChEMBL, BindingDB, PharmGKB), expression (GTEx), pathways (GO, Reactome), nutrition (USDA FDC), recipes (RecipeNLG + Food.com + Epicurious + Indian Food + six new corpora), and identity hubs (HGNC, UniProt, Wikidata) — were reconciled across 18 identifier namespaces into one 695-ingredient mechanism+nutrition graph.

counts_verification_notes: RecipeNLG 2,231,142 counted from full_dataset.csv rows; expanded_v2 retains 1,261,019 recipenlg recipes after processing filters.
recipes5.csv has 620 rows with ingredients (earlier line-count tools that reported ~3k were wrong or counted differently); live ingest used 620.
USDA food parquet has 2.06M food rows; nutrient joins cover 1.95M distinct fdc_ids — FDC is a large catalog, species map uses a curated subset.
Phenol-Explorer and Human Protein Atlas are present on disk; product tissue profiles use GTEx, not HPA.
recipes_1.csv is on disk but was not ingested (no ingredients).
recipes4.csv and recipes4.json are duplicates of one corpus (62,126 recipes).
